name: business-gap-finder
description: 1. Launch Google Antigravity on your Mac and open the **Agent Manager** (Mission Control). 2. Create a new workspace named `Market_Opportunity_Scout`. 3. Check the terminal execution settings. Set terminal execution to **Auto**. This ensures the agent can independently run `npm install` and scaffold the React/Node environments but will prompt you for permission before executing sensitive system-level commands.
